review_output: {"summary":"I reviewed only the supplied files. The presentation changes do what they set out to do. PolicyDocument no longer renders draft status, owner, headings or paragraphs. The shared footer and the index and support pages are customer-facing, with no invented contact or SLA, and the original paths are retained. I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issues. There are two non-blocking findings. One is a pre-existing slug lookup that can return a 500 instead of a 404. The other is a wording nit on the effective-date label. This does not certify tests, accessibility, a Next dev rendering or a production build. The Next dev rendering, a11y run and production build are still unrun.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/app/policies/[slug]/page.tsx","area":"generateMetadata and PolicyPage: `policyDrafts[slug]` lookup","issue":"The lookup indexes a plain object with a user-controlled slug. Inherited property names such as `constructor`, `toString` and `hasOwnProperty` return a truthy non-draft value, so `notFound()` is never called.","evidence":"`const draft = policyDrafts[slug]; if (!draft) notFound();` `policyDrafts` is a `Record<string, PolicyDraft>` object literal. `generateStaticParams` does not set `dynamicParams = false`, so unknown slugs are rendered on demand. For `/policies/constructor`, `draft` is `Object`, and `publicPolicyTitle(draft)` calls `draft.title.replace` on `undefined` and throws.","impact":"Public URLs such as `/policies/constructor` or `/policies/toString` return a 500 error instead of the 404 page. Metadata generation also throws. No content leaks. This predates the WP03 change but sits in the route being reviewed.","recommended_fix":"Resolve the draft only for own keys, for example `Object.hasOwn(policyDrafts, slug) ? policyDrafts[slug] : undefined`. Apply the same check in `generateMetadata` and in the page. Alternatively, export `dynamicParams = false`.","required_test":"Add a route test for slugs `constructor`, `toString` and `__proto__`. `generateMetadata` should return `{}` for each. `PolicyPage` should trigger `notFound` for each.","confidence":0.75},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/components/public-policy.tsx","area":"PolicyDocument: `<dl data-policy-publication>` value \"尚未生效\"","issue":"The effective-date field says \"尚未生效\" (not yet in effect). That is a status claim. The only supported fact is that no approved version or date has been announced.","evidence":"The code comment says D-5 has supplied no approved version or date, and no registry exists. The notice text, \"正式政策內容與生效日期尚未公告\", is the accurate wording. The dd values \"尚未發布\" and \"尚未生效\" assert state. The tests assert \"尚未生效\" on every policy page.","impact":"If any terms or agreements are actually binding outside this site, the page tells users they are not in effect. That is a small truthfulness and legal-adjacent risk. The unknown-date goal is met either way.","recommended_fix":"Use a neutral label such as \"尚未公告\" for the effective date, and keep \"尚未發布\" for the version if that matches the accepted boundary. Update the three tests and the e2e assertion accordingly.","required_test":"Update the public-policy unit, slug-page and e2e assertions from \"尚未生效\" to the chosen neutral wording. Confirm that `article time` still has count 0.","confidence":0.4}]}
